# Current-runtime upgrade foundation fixtures

These are synthetic, target-content-neutral recognition fixtures. The fixture
set manifest seals every contract and target file by SHA-256. No target script,
source, archive, map, client, or database from a user server is included or
executed.

The targets isolate the first classifier boundaries: exact Preservation-like
T0, typed configuration T2A, portable declarative data T2B, a recognized
plugin/core ABI coupling that needs a T4 port, an unknown binary-only T5
refusal, and a synthetic trusted managed-N ledger.
